duration.text: The Applied Chemistry at Taizhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1)Scanned copy of passport front page;(2)Scanned copies of high school graduationcertificate and transcript or equivalent educationalcertificate and transcript. Master's students arerequired to provide their undergraduate graduationcertificate andtranscript;(3)Scanned copies of physical examination reportsissued bydesignated medical institutions ordesignated hospitals in Taizhou City outside thecountry (territory) by the Chinese government;(4)Scanned copies of Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK)score level certificate and/or English Proficiency Test(IELTS, TOEFL) certificate;(5)Scanned copyof $3000 economic guaranteecertificate;(6)1-2 scanned copies of recommendation letters;(7) Certificate of no criminal record;(8) One electronic photo.

requirements.text: (1)Foreign citizens holding foreign passports;(2)The physical health condition meets the medical examination requirements for visaapplication stipulated by the National lmmigration Administration;(3) Age not exceeding 25 years old;(4)Having a high school diploma or equivalent educational background;(5)For subjects and majors that use English as the language of instruction, non-nativeEnglish speaking applicants must achieve an English proficiency level of IELTS 6.0 Or TOEFL69. Applicants without an English proficiency certificate must provide a 3-minute Englishlanguage video;(6)Students are required to undergo an interview organized by the school during theapplication process (which can be done remotely).
